assumptions: Finite simple two-neighborhood split hosts with core K_r, actual short set A, p short leaves and q long leaves.
Full-face claim means the optimal equality nu_star=m/3 or lambda=m/3, not only feasibility of the all-one-third dual.
The uniform fixed-K3 gap gamma(n)=o(n^2) is imported source-backed from C22 with its exact quantifier order.
All complete-split and two-split pieces are edge-disjoint clique partitions; no Q, L_D, J_fix, J or nu identification is made.

atomic_claims.text: There is an absolute n0 such that every n-vertex two-neighborhood split host on the full one-third triangle-packing face satisfies cp(G)<=n^2/6+1, hence the ProblemContract form with C=1 on this entire subclass.
For core order r and total leaf count s, n^2/6-[C(r,2)+rs]/3=(s^2+r)/6; when s>(2-sqrt(3))r this fixed quadratic margin absorbs the uniform triangle-packing o(n^2) error with a single fixed epsilon.
For every two-neighborhood split host, cp<=n^2/6+Delta_f+2gamma(n)-(s^2+r)/6, where Delta_f=lambda-m/3. Outside the sparse direct region, any asymptotic root obstruction must have quadratic Delta_f.
The host edge set splits exactly into J(a,p+q) and J(r-a,a+q), yielding additional root-safe parameter regions; a separate J(r,q)+short-singletons decomposition gives another sufficient inequality.

Final generator-side exact runs check 48503 algebra rows, 3065 bounded C28 face rows, 286 complete parameter representations through original order eight with exact cp and nu, complete-split factorizations through order forty, and 12 rejected mutations.

objective: Integrate C22 and merged C34 to prove the original n^2/6+O(n) inequality on the entire full-one-third two-neighborhood split face by a sparse-leaf/direct versus quadratic-margin/uniform-o(n^2) dichotomy; localize every remaining two-level root obstruction to quadratic fractional face excess.
risks: The uniform o(n^2) dependency is not re-proved or independently attested in this transaction.
The theorem does not prove nu_star-nu=O(r) on the full face; C32-C34 retain stronger packing results only on their stated subdomains.
High face-excess nonuniform-dual instances remain open and include complete-split extremal scaling.
